abilities.description:
EQUIP <whitebold>Poison Cloud</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. REACTIVATE to consume fuel to create a <whitebold>toxic</> smoke that <debuffred>decays</> enemies.

Can be picked up during BUY PHASE.
EQUIP <whitebold>Toxic Screen</>. FIRE to send forward and place a line of emitters. REACTIVATE to consume fuel to create a <whitebold>toxic</> vision-blocking wall that <debuffred>decays</> enemies.
EQUIP <whitebold>Snake Bite</>. FIRE to launch. On landing, create a zone that grants <debuffred>vulnerable</> and deals low <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

EQUIP <whitebold>Viper’s Pit</>. FIRE to form a large <whitebold>toxic</> vision-blocking cloud that <debuffred>decays</> enemies inside.

HOLD ACTIVATE to cancel the cloud.
Viper’s <whitebold>Toxin</> continuously inflicts <debuffred>decay</> when enemies come in contact. Passively recharge fuel over time.
EQUIP <whitebold>High Tide</>. FIRE to send forward a vision-blocking wall that <debuffred>slows</> all players who come in contact. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair. ALT FIRE to stop early.
EQUIP <whitebold>Storm Surge</>. FIRE to throw. Explodes on landing, <debuffred>nearsighting</> and <debuffred>slowing</> all players.
ENTER The Deep. REACTIVATE to cast a smoke. HOLD FIRE/ALT FIRE to adjust distance. RELOAD to toggle view. After casting, REACTIVATE to transform the smoke into a destructible shield.
EQUIP <whitebold>Reckoning</>. FIRE to push forward a vision-blocking wall that <debuffred>nearsights</> and <debuffred>slows</> all players who come in contact. REACTIVATE to stop the wall early.

INSTANTLY consume fuel to gain <teal>haste</>. REACTIVATE to cancel. ALT FIRE to slide forward or in your movement direction.

Slide resets every two kills.
INSTANTLY throw a bolt that bounces once. Explodes on each surface, <debuffred>concussing</> all players.
INSTANTLY launch two vision-blocking walls that extend until they hit a surface.

INSTANTLY refresh <whitebold>High Gear</>. Access an accurate lightning beam that can be used while activating <whitebold>High Gear</>.

FIRE to shoot. On kills, fully recharge fuel.
Passively recharge fuel over time.
EQUIP <whitebold>FRAG/ment</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. Explodes on landing, repeatedly dealing pulses of <debuffred>damage</> to all players.
EQUIP a <whitebold>FLASH/drive</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. After a delay, explode, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.
EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>ZERO/point</>. FIRE to throw. Pulses on any surface, <debuffred>suppressing</> enemies within range.

INSTANTLY gain <teal>overloaded</> and repeatedly send out a pulse that <debuffred>suppresses</> enemies within range.

<teal>Overloaded</> grants <teal>combat stim</>. Upon taking <debuffred>lethal damage</>, KAY/O is downed and can be re-stabilized.

EQUIP <whitebold>Flashbulb</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to prepare it instead. REACTIVATE to direct it towards your crosshair. Explodes on any surface or after a delay, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

EQUIP <whitebold>Displacement</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to prepare it instead. REACTIVATE to direct it towards your crosshair. Explodes on any surface or after a delay, <debuffred>pulling</> all players towards the center and <debuffred>concussing</> them if they collide with any surface or another player.

Resets every two kills.
INSTANTLY create an anchor. If Hush is in the air, briefly levitate in place. After a delay, propel towards it.
INSTANTLY prepare <whitebold>Suspension</>. FIRE to send it forward, steering with your crosshair. REACTIVATE or press FIRE again to detonate, <debuffred>levitating</> all players.
Hush can pick up weapons, the Spike, and INTERACT with switches from an increased range.
